verdict.rationale: Claude is the core of the product. Users describe a visual and Claude builds a first version, refines it through conversation, applies the design system automatically, creates custom sliders and packages handoff bundles for Claude Code. Teams can also chat with Claude together. Hands-on reports confirm real delegation, such as a shippable landing page built in hours and a solid handoff skill, though users note the last 20% still needs human judgment and careful prompting. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the limits of multi-step delegation, and evidence that the assistant reliably self-corrects without repeated user guidance.
